submittedArguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original native 1254 x 1254 terrain patch precisely continuing the approved hand-painted fantasy game map. Image 1 is the exact local layout: repaint its existing shapes with crisp native detail; its blur is only a coordinate guide, never final pixels. Image 2 is the north native strip matching the top 230 pixels. Image 3 is the west native strip matching the left 230 pixels. Preserve the positions, surface transitions and edge geometry of both strips; do not stretch, resize or invent forms. Image 4 is the approved full map for art direction only, not objects to copy into this patch. Pale golden sand appears only across upper-left to upper-middle, ending near y=200..250 in the layout. Preserve white shallow surf across upper/central part and turquoise water across lower and right areas. The broad pale region is transparent shallow water and irregular thin foam, not extra dry sand. Keep a continuous gentle shoreline, do not make islands, dry-land peninsulas, boulders or objects. Wave mesh scale and hue must match native north and west strips. Refined rounded Q Daoist hand-painted game art, diffuse bright daylight, same elevated camera and object scale, restrained mineral detail and painterly surface depth. No added rocks, architecture, vegetation, props, characters, text, interface, borders or grid markings. Native original detail, not an enlarged overview. Output the complete square terrain patch, no reference montage.
